verdict.rationale: Qdrant's own docs describe collection snapshots as tar archives holding a collection's data and configuration at a point in time, which covers the backup half of the story. Nothing in the evidence describes restoring from a snapshot or how snapshots are created through the API. missing for 10: documented restore/recovery procedure, snapshot creation/download API details, handling of distributed/multi-node snapshots, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can back up collections with snapshots and restore them

citations.quote: Snapshots are tar archive files that contain data and configuration of a specific collection on a specific node at a specific time.
Snapshots are `tar` archive files that contain data and configuration of a specific collection on a specific node at a specific time.
